name: AI Media Agency Phase 1 Policy Profile
description: DRAFT simulation-only policy profile for AGS-governed AI media agency Phase 1.

tools.notes: Simulation-only paid content tests require CEO approval.

environments.notes: Production live agency actions are out of scope for Phase 1.

approvalRules.reason: Every spend-like action requires exact CEO approval in Phase 1.

dataSensitivity.notes: High sensitivity workflows are out of scope for Phase 1 unless separately reviewed.

hardBoundaries.label: No live spend in Phase 1
hardBoundaries.reason: Live spend is not allowed in Phase 1.

hardBoundaries.label: No public posting in Phase 1
hardBoundaries.reason: Public posting is not allowed in Phase 1.

hardBoundaries.label: No external direct messages in Phase 1
hardBoundaries.reason: External direct messages are not allowed in Phase 1.

hardBoundaries.label: No credential access in Phase 1
hardBoundaries.reason: Payment and social-platform credentials are not available in Phase 1.

hardBoundaries.label: No operational-agent policy mutation
hardBoundaries.reason: Operational agents and LLMs may not mutate governance policy.

hardBoundaries.label: No agent self-approval
hardBoundaries.reason: Operational agents may request approval but may not approve their own proposals.

hardBoundaries.label: No unconsented real-person likeness or impersonation
hardBoundaries.reason: Synthetic personas must be represented as synthetic/AI identities.

hardBoundaries.label: No fabricated human credentials or experiences
hardBoundaries.reason: AI personas may not claim fabricated human credentials, purchases, testimonials, personal results, or real-world experiences.

hardBoundaries.label: No Phase 1 sensitive-domain workflows
hardBoundaries.reason: Political persuasion, medical claims, personalized financial claims, adult/sensitive-content monetization, and sensitive-personal-data workflows are out of scope for Phase 1.

metadata.metadataBindingLimitation: Budget, platform, property, campaign, content, audience, and experiment-window values are preserved in metadata but are not currently Runtime Binding fields.
